solution:

☛ "Extended" (stretched), "recommended" (suggested), and "ascended" (climbed up) are irrelevant in this context.
☛ Grammar Rule: "Descend from" is a phrasal verb used to denote ancestry. The present perfect tense (has + V3) is used here because it describes an action that started in the past and continues to the present.
